==Description==
This template is intended for description of the "light side" choices occurring during the main questline in a game, where such a choice has not specifically been declared canon. Optional content should instead use {{Tl|GameLSmechanics}} (light side) or {{Tl|Gamemechanics}} (neutral).

==Usage==
Use the format <code><nowiki>{{GameLS|</nowiki>{{Var|Name of game}}}}</code> for a specific game. The {{Para|canon|1}} parameter should be used for [[Canon]] articles. Close assumption sections with {{Tl|Endgame}}.
